name: Christians Celebrating Halloween
overview: Scripture calls Christians to be transformed by the renewing of their minds and to avoid conforming to worldly practices, emphasizing the need to cast off works of darkness and put on the armor of light. While believers are to receive those weak in faith without engaging in doubtful disputations, they must be cautious not to give place to the devil or make the word of God ineffective through tradition. Training children in the way they should go is vital for lifelong faithfulness, which challenges Christians to carefully consider the spiritual implications of participating in celebrations like Halloween.
